prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE complete, premium Chinese desktop WEBSITE PAGE DESIGN image, not a moodboard, not a device mockup, not multiple screens. Native high resolution requested: 2048 x 2736 px portrait, or highest supported native size. Crisp Chinese lettering, generous readable typographic hierarchy, realistic implementable web layout, main content flat and legible. Whole page including header, 3-4 well-proportioned content sections and footer visible; no browser chrome. No montage of two references. Primary design inheritance: reference 09's medical academic journal typography, paper/printed-book tactility and calm editorial reading. Secondary: reference 06's architectural light, rhythm and scholarly display. Blend coherently into one art direction. Overall academic, credible, warm, restrained. No neon, outer space, holographic panels, luminous graphs floating over text, giant decorations obscuring content. Soft muted medical blue accents. Keep a small triangular loop TONGXUE brand mark as in the references, not a new logo. Header readable: “TONGXUE” (use English wordmark only; do not invent a Chinese brand character), “首页”, “科研成果”, “能力中心”, “论文服务”, button “开启科研咨询”. No invented empirical claims or commercial promises. Charts are visual layout illustrations only. Footer small: “视觉概念 · 图表为版式示意”. This is a static page image; generated text should prioritize the exact short Chinese headings given below, additional text must be short, factual and unobtrusive. Natural architectural illumination occupies visual areas only; text sits on opaque light paper backgrounds.
ART DIRECTION 05 长桌共研: 桌面期刊工作坊 × 开放阅览空间。把科研协作呈现为同坐一张长桌阅读与推敲。纸册、图表和注释按工作次序排开，空间温暖但保持专业整洁。
COMPOSITION: 品牌标题置于顶端左上，宽幅斜向长桌横贯首屏；内容区以两栏大模块组织，强调关联而非碎卡。
MATERIALS/LIGHT: 浅橡木、自然白书纸、磨砂金属书挡；多扇高窗带来均匀日光。
DISTINCTIVENESS: 独有俯斜视角的长桌与连续桌面分区；核心不是一本孤立书册，而是按角色组织的同一研究资料。
PALETTE: [['纸感背景', '#F2EEE5'], ['阅读面板', '#FEFCF6'], ['强调色', '#6B8175'], ['正文', '#303D3A']]
PAGE CONTENT: 首页，必须选中导航“首页”。大标题逐字使用“医学之问，与智能共研。”，副文案“面向临床医生与医学科研团队，连接临床洞察与严谨学术探索。”，主按钮“探索能力中心”“了解科研协作”。在首屏之后按清楚层级展示：“同一份好奇，一起走得更远”品牌短句；三项能力小橱窗“3D 空间解剖”“论文深度解构”“科研图表生成”；一行“科研成果与交付”入口；底部咨询行动。不画全量能力工作台，不画重型3D应用。
STRICT CONTENT RULES: Do not invent any publication dates, year stamps, patient counts, performance metrics, study names, journal covers/brands (no Lancet/NEJM/JAMA), biographies, testimonials, pricing or promises. The ONLY named research project anywhere is “MIMIC-IV 脓毒症 AKI 预警研究”. All other labels must be exactly the short feature/deliverable headings supplied. Use generic unbranded medical books. If a section needs filler use empty breathing space or a botanical-free neutral paper illustration, not new content.
The results/service preview section has exactly TWO entries: “MIMIC-IV 脓毒症 AKI 预警研究” with “查看科研成果”, and “标准化科研交付包” with “了解论文服务”. No third study card, no date or journal label. Keep name TONGXUE only in image.
OVERRIDE PRIOR LAYOUT: MANDATORY UNIQUE PAGE COMPOSITION: Recompose as a broad editorial worktable, NOT the common left text/right big book hero. Put the two-line brand headline in a slim FULL-WIDTH masthead band with short subtitle and two buttons. Below it show a wide, top-down / shallow oblique shared oak research desk occupying only 22% of total page height. Then use TWO LARGE ASYMMETRIC CONTENT COLUMNS: left column is a numbered vertical list of all three capability entries with compact illustrations (not a row of three cards), right column is a manuscript reading panel and a small combined research/deliverable section with the two specified entries. End in a full-width consultation band. Keep plentiful paper white margins, blue-green ink. The overall page must visibly have a different information architecture from the reference. No people, no dates, no invented data.
